These southern survey kari meat responses select the meat sense of that culinary family, retaining the source non-retroflex rhotic spelling. Precise inter-lect transmission is not established by the widespread culinary term alone. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1254 gives Tamil kayiṟu, Malayalam kayaṟu rope/cord and Kodagu kērï. Selected survey kayir-/kavar-/kagar-/kahar- forms are proposed comparative lect reflexes of the same rope stem, preserving intervocalic glide, labial, velar or fricative notation. More divergent Muthuvan kadɨrɨ/kadarɨ responses are excluded pending stronger sound evidence. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Longer side/hand compounds and Indo-Aryan ḍāva/ḍebri-type terms remain separate. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
